heading: Crafting seamless and intuitive digital experiences.
description: UX research and interface design for a fintech startup.
fullDescription: We collaborated with a fintech startup to redesign their mobile banking app. The project involved user interviews, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. The result was a 40% increase in user retention and a 25% boost in daily active users.

heading: Telling captivating stories through art and visuals.
description: Brand identity and packaging design for a craft brewery.
fullDescription: We created a complete brand identity for a new craft brewery, including logo, color palette, typography, and packaging designs. The project also included social media templates and merchandise design.

heading: Shaping a brand that stands out and resonates.
description: Full branding and website design for a sustainable fashion brand.
fullDescription: We helped a sustainable fashion brand establish a cohesive brand identity, from logo and visual language to a custom Shopify website. The project included product photography, copywriting, and SEO optimization.

heading: Revolutionizing user experience with innovative designs.
description: E‑commerce platform redesign focusing on conversion optimization.
fullDescription: We redesigned an e‑commerce platform to improve user flow and conversion rates. Key features included a simplified checkout process, personalized product recommendations, and a modern visual refresh.

heading: Creating a logo that speaks louder than words.
description: Minimalist logo and brand guidelines for a tech startup.
fullDescription: We designed a versatile, minimalist logo for a tech startup along with a comprehensive brand guidelines document covering usage, color codes, and typography.

heading: Designing user-focused and accessible interfaces.
description: Accessibility audit and redesign for a government portal.
fullDescription: We conducted an accessibility audit for a government portal and implemented WCAG 2.1 AA compliant redesign. The project included keyboard navigation improvements, screen reader compatibility, and high contrast modes.
